{"candidate_rtl":"`default_nettype none\nmodule crc32_d8(input wire [7:0] data_in, input wire [31:0] state_in, output wire [7:0] data_out, output wire [31:0] state_out);\n    reg [31:0] state;\n    reg [7:0] shifted_data;\n    reg feedback;\n    integer i;\n\n    always @* begin\n        for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1)\n            state[i] = state_in[31-i];\n        shifted_data = 8'b0;\n        feedback = 1'b0;\n        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin\n            feedback = state[31] ^ data_in[i];\n            shifted_data[i] = feedback;\n            state = {state[30:0], feedback} ^ ({32{feedback}} & 32'h04c11db6);\n        end\n    end\n\n    genvar k;\n    generate\n        for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1) begin : gen_data\n            assign data_out[k] = shifted_data[k];\n        end\n        for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin : gen_state\n            assign state_out[k] = state[31-k];\n        end\n    endgenerate\nendmodule\n`default_nettype wire\n","bottleneck":"The original implementation creates forty independent wide reduction-XOR cones from generated masks. The rewrite shares the eight Galois feedback terms and the common state-transition logic across all outputs.","rewrite":"Implemented the fixed CRC32 Galois transform as an eight-step combinational recurrence, with the reflected input/output ordering preserved explicitly. The polynomial feedback mask excludes bit zero because the shift recurrence already inserts the feedback bit there.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected improvement from shared feedback logic and reduced duplicated parity-cone construction; exact gain depends on ABC rewriting and buffering, with the principal target being the longest data-to-state path.","area_or_other_cost":"Uses eight shared combinational transition stages and therefore may trade some local depth for lower duplicated XOR area. No storage, clocks, latches, memories, or additional external logic are introduced.","functional_boundaries":"Exact for all 8-bit data_in and 32-bit state_in values for the fixed CRC32_d8 instance. Preserves the original GALOIS polynomial 32'h04c11db7, feed-forward disabled behavior, reflected input/output ordering, data_out feedback sequence, widths, and combinational semantics."}
